set.body: Parse mono3/binocular5-character CR warning tokens only under declared CR tracking. Retain raw token, interpolation and per-eye missing/recovery flags distinctly from absent flags and from missing gaze/blink inference. Preserve existing numeric-only exported layouts; never infer eye/mode/rate from width. Malformed flags produce source/line/block/layout/value diagnostic, recorded in the shared catalog. Unit and machine parity tests on JVM/JS; publication support only after full real fixture workflow.
set.title: Retain optional native CR warning flags in declared EyeLink sample layouts
